result.title: Know What You Don't Know: Agentic Data Synthesis by Evolving Generation Space for Closed-Loop Learning
result.summary: The continued improvement of large language models increasingly depends on synthetic experience, yet effective data synthesis for interactive agents requires not only executable and verifiable trajectories, but also interactions that provide learning value for the current task agent. Existing methods increasingly incorporate environment feedback, data validation, or learner failures, but still face a feedback-to-decision gap: observed weaknesses do not directly specify how future synthesis should change, or whether they can be represented by the current synthesis space. To address this gap, we propose EvoSyn, a learning-feedback-driven multi-agent framework that organizes synthesis around a revisable state specifying what interaction factors can be deliberately generated and where synthesis effort should be allocated. A role-specialized multi-agent system translates learner feedback into synthesis revisions, while a Designer allocates synthesis directions and a Planner grounds them into executable experience. This process enables within-space adaptation toward weak or under-covered regions and synthesis-space expansion that promotes newly discovered factors into explicit generation controls. Experiments on $τ^2$-Bench and CAR-Bench show that EvoSyn improves average task success by 13.3 points over the strongest synthesis baseline, while producing higher-quality and structurally broader synthetic experience and discovering controllable factors missed without learner feedback.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EvoSyn：一个由学习反馈驱动的多智能体数据合成框架，用一个可修订状态刻画可刻意生成的交互因子及合成资源分配，由多角色系统把学习者的失败反馈转成合成方案，在 τ²-Bench 与 CAR-Bench 上平均任务成功率提升 13.3 点。
AI.relevance_reason: 工作本身是纯文本交互 agent 的轨迹合成，与视觉 latent 推理无直接关系；但其「可修订合成状态 + 按学习者未知/薄弱区域分配生成、并扩展生成空间」的思路，可能为 latent 推理的轨迹训练监督与数据贡献分配提供可供核查的方法线索。
